detailed_description:
The target video is a single continuous take in the same setting as <Picture 1>, with its light and its background left exactly as they are. [Shot 1] A tight locked-off close-up holds <Subject 1>'s head and the top of their shoulders, their face filling most of the frame, cropped just below the collarbone, with the background softly out of focus behind them. They begin facing the camera with a calm, quietly observant expression and their lips lightly closed. Across the whole shot they turn their head and shoulders slowly and continuously to their own left in one smooth unbroken motion, passing through a three-quarter view and continuing all the way to a full side profile, ending with the nose, lips and chin drawn cleanly against the background. The chin stays level and the gaze follows the direction of the turn. Their large horizontally elongated almond eyes with visible sclera around the irises, their short brow-to-eye distance, their dark fairly straight brows, their lean youthful midface, their skin texture and their hair remain stable and physically coherent from the first frame to the last. In profile the nasal bridge runs straight from the brow toward the tip with no dorsal hump, no aquiline curve and no hooked or drooping tip, and the chin stays softly rounded and does not jut forward. There is no speech and no change of expression.
overall_soundscape: A quiet neutral room tone and nothing else.
non_diegetic_music: None.
